signatureAndBinding: exact raw bytes are signed with the explicit IM app pair
wrong app, unknown selector and foreign seller binding fail closed
a Verify-shaped message cannot bypass raw persistence
ackAndRecovery: database rejection or thrown persistence error is not acknowledged as success
the same receipt is idempotent and replay does not extend retention
a live lease token prevents duplicate claims
completion occurs only after quarantine and inquiry projection
completion transport loss and malformed claims fail closed
transient failures back off and the fifth failure becomes terminal evidence
limits: expiry pruning leaves body-free evidence for unprocessed receipts
empty-page-with-next, repeated/forward/missing cursors and overfull pages do not become success
cardsAndRevisions: unknown templates and unknown types remain explicit non-customer events
same message ID normal-to-recalled converges on the recalled revision in either arrival order
same message ID with changed body or attachment remains conflict evidence
timeAndRole: missing native send time is not replaced with envelope or collection time
official session tags are retained through bootstrap projection
official and undocumented-template messages do not become replyable customers
seller-only history does not invent a buyer
attachments: native URL observations use a bounded private evidence ledger
refresh observations are distinguished from retained URL-only evidence
expired or deleted evidence is enforced at read time
the health contract reports URL-only retention instead of claiming binary recovery
